title: [WHT]-Withholding Tax is not deducted from Expense Report lines based on the Expense Category during posting
summary: Withholding tax is now deducted from expense report lines during posting based on the expense category. The change adds new objects in the ExpenseWithholdingTax app and touches Expense Report posting, the WithholdingTax employee codeunits and Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in all layers.
key_points: Expense Report-Post codeunit updated so withholding tax is handled during expense report posting
ExpenseWithholdingTax app gains a buffer table, a posting handler codeunit, a General Journal page extension and a permission set
Gen. Jnl.-Post Line modified in W1 and every country layer, plus changes to the WithholdingTax employee calculation and subscriber codeunits
Build configuration and AL-Go project settings updated across country projects
